description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying at most {4}{G}.
Witch-Maw Nephilim's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve Sprout Swarm, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Cast Sprout Swarm by paying {4} and tapping the Saproling token.
Witch-Maw Nephilim's first ability triggers; holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Witch-Maw Nephilim trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Servos and/or the Saprolings.
